item.title: Arkansas TV Commission puts hold on PBS disaffiliation pending funding
item.description: The Arkansas TV Commission has agreed to hold off on the disenfranchisement of PBS and Arkansas TV until alternate funding sources can be found to cover the additional $2 million needed to maintain PBS programming.

item.title: Traffic Alert: Banana Ball weekend in North Little Rock
item.description: The Banana Ball Championship League is bringing two games to CHI St. Vincent Field at Dickey-Stephens Park this weekend, resulting in heavy traffic and delays in downtown North Little Rock due to multiple overlapping events, including the 25th Annual St. Patrick's Day Parade and a Chicago concert at Simmons Bank Arena.

item.title: Documentary of Little Rock filmmaker killed in Ukraine nominated for Oscar
item.description: An Oscar-nominated documentary, "Armed Only With a Camera: The Life and Death of Brent Renaud", tells the story of Brent Renaud, an Arkansas filmmaker who was killed while reporting on the war in Ukraine, and his decades-long career documenting people caught in the middle of conflicts around the world.
